our_interpretation: By now asserts a completed change by February 5, 2024. Despite the future-perfect phrasing, this is an observation about the state at publication, not a future forecast.
This specific example refers to the lawsuit reproduction illustrated in the post, not every New York Times reproduction or every memorization attack.
Support requires evidence both of a filtering change affecting that example and of its effect on reproducibility. A general anti-regurgitation policy is insufficient.
The target is the deployed system's state on February 5, 2024. Earlier statements and later tests are context unless they establish that historical state.
criteria.support_condition: A dated technical disclosure, deployment record, or adequately controlled contemporaneous test establishes that OpenAI had blocked reproduction of the illustrated example by February 5, 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented successful replication on the relevant deployed system at the target date, or reliable records establishing that the asserted filter was absent or ineffective then.
